## Problem

What breaks or what is missing, and the requested scope. A pre-existing issue
is optional; link one when relevant (`Fixes #123` only when this PR fully
resolves it). For reverts, link the PR or commit being reverted. For
security-sensitive fixes that cannot be tracked publicly, follow
maintainer-approved private tracking.

## Approach

Why this change solves the problem — the reasoning behind the approach, not a restatement of the diff.

## Scope

What changed. If anything outside the core fix was touched, explain why it was necessary. New tests are not expected by default — if any were added, justify why each is needed.
